messages:
Priya S.: Quick sync from today's regional failover table-top. Capturing action items and owners so we don't lose momentum. Short thread, please ack and add ETA.

Tom B.: ack. I'll take ownership of the traffic-steering playbook updates (weights + health-check rules). Will draft changes and a canary test harness. ETA: 2026-04-04.

Ethan R.: I'll validate backup TTLs and ensure snapshots are cross-region replicated. Saw some gaps on cold buckets during the sim. ETA: 2026-03-31.

Nora K.: I'll own the restore runbook end-to-end (incl. perms checklist and post-restore verification). Will add explicit runbook steps for S3 roles and key rotation. ETA: 2026-04-02.

Priya S.: please note recurring incident pattern: failed KV warmup and stale DNS TTLs causing traffic to route to an empty pool. Need both infra and DNS mitigations.

DevOps-bot: DR-tabletop-2026-03-25 completed. Attachments: https://internal/archives/dr-tabletop-2026-03-25.zip

Tom B.: agree on DNS TTLs. I'll add emergency DNS override instructions + automated low-TTL path for migration windows. ETA for doc: 2026-03-29.

Ethan R.: question for Nora 1: when you add perms checklist, can you include a safe rollback plan if S3 access is broken after restore? We hit that in the sim and had to escalate.

Nora K.: yes. I'll include a quick test sequence that validates read/write with temporary credentials before switching live traffic. Also adding checksum verification step.

Audrey M.: I'll run a short audit of model routing rules; we saw two services route to an incompatible quantized model variant during failover. I'll add an automated compatibility gate in the deployment pipeline. ETA: 2026-04-03.

Priya S.: concise owner table for tracking sheet:
- Traffic steering & canary harness: Tom B. 1 ETA 2026-04-04
- Backup cross-region replication + TTL audit: Ethan R. 1 ETA 2026-03-31
- Restore runbook + perms + rollback: Nora K. 1 ETA 2026-04-02
- Model variant compatibility gate: Audrey M. 1 ETA 2026-04-03
- DNS emergency override doc: Tom B. 1 ETA 2026-03-29

Priya S.: let's aim for an on-prem + hosted rehearsal (mini game day) on 2026-04-09 if all PRs land. We'll do a short checklist run: 1) snapshot restore, 2) model compatibility checks, 3) traffic shift test.

Tom B.: I'll publish the canary harness in the infra repo and add a README for running it locally. Will ping infra-qa for a dry run.

Ethan R.: started a replication audit ticket and attached initial findings. Link: https://internal/tickets/BR-9123

Nora K.: opening PR for runbook changes today, will tag reviewers and include the perms test script.

Audrey M.: adding pipeline gate as a pre-deploy check. Will include a small unit test that verifies model_manifest compatibility.

Priya S.: thanks all. Quick ask: when you PR, paste the link here and update the DR tracker. I'll run a readiness check on 2026-04-07 and call the game day if green. :thumbsup:

DevOps-bot: Reminder: follow-ups must be recorded in the DR-tracker before 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC.
